fusions.name: Scent Taken
fusions.desc: Needs one of your afflictions on the target and uses it up. A thrust that deals 9 damage, up to 1.8 times that at maximum range.

fusions.name: Rushing Maw
fusions.desc: Lunges the tines wide in a cone that deals 36 damage to everything caught in it, and 5% of a boss or elite target's maximum health.

fusions.name: Blood in the Water
fusions.desc: For 8 seconds, 50% of the damage you take is dealt back to whoever dealt it. Each kill you make while it is active restores 8 health.

fusions.name: Taste of It
fusions.desc: When you kill an enemy, you heal for 25% of the damage you deal for 6 seconds. Once every 8 seconds.
